run_time_func_benchmark: run time_func to benchmark a callable over 100 iterations and print average ms per call
test_time_func_with_custom_iterations: test time_func with a custom number of iterations to measure execution time of a function
test_time_func_with_name: test time_func with a custom name label to identify the benchmarked function in output
review_time_func_warmup: review time_func warmup logic that runs 5 preliminary calls before measuring performance
summarize_time_func: summarize time_func which uses perf_counter to measure and report average execution time in milliseconds
